answer: Each challenge is derived from a task commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable value cannot be known when agents prepare responses or farm challenges offline. After the pulse is published, nodes can verify the derivation and response against the commitment. This blocks advance computation and replay across identities; it does not prove one-person-one-account, but makes automated sybil swarms repeat work for each fresh challenge, whether labeled onyx, crystal, or jetty.
